unit.title: Security Boundaries and Fail-Closed Authorization
unit.scope: Threat-model, design, implement, and test a small in-memory authorization core in Go; authentication, networking, persistence, and cryptographic protocols are explicitly out of scope.
prerequisites: Comfort with data structures and asymptotic reasoning
Ability to write and test a small Go package
Basic familiarity with processes, memory, and concurrency
learning_objectives: State assets, actors, trust boundaries, assumptions, and exclusions before implementation
Translate an authorization policy into explicit invariants and fail-closed behavior
Prevent representation leaks and partial state changes at an API boundary
Make security-relevant state transitions safe under concurrent use
Produce adversarial tests and command evidence for engineering claims

unit_completion.required_artifacts: All learner artifacts listed in unit.learner_artifacts
